purpose: Translate only the predeclared synthetic rescue-vs-worsening discriminator into empirical measurement priorities without changing the already-frozen network-context prediction rules.
scientific_update: Strong synthetic sign rescue is associated most clearly with maintaining repeated local interaction opportunity through time/context: rescue cases preserve active-context fraction and lose fewer positive partners than attenuation-only or worsening cases. Initial trait position is not a strong rescue-vs-attenuation discriminator in this block.

priorities.definition: For each focal plant/population and prespecified observation context, record whether at least one admissible plant-pollinator interaction opportunity remains locally present; summarize the fraction of contexts with positive support.
priorities.why: Synthetic sign-rescue mean island-mainland active-context delta is 0.0, versus approximately -0.409 for both attenuation-only and worsening classes.

priorities.definition: Count positive visitor partners per matched local context using the same effort and plant-state denominator across comparison populations.
priorities.why: Sign-rescue cases lose about 0.80 partners island-minus-mainland on average, versus about 2.24 for attenuation-only and 1.95 for worsening cases.

priorities.definition: Measure or recover direct per-visit pollen/service outcome E_k for each materially contributing visitor so partner retention can be converted into effective service sum_k(V_k * E_k).
priorities.why: Support retention is only a mechanistic service explanation if retained partners actually deliver direct service. This remains the decisive blocker for Guaiacum and is provenance-blocked for Nicotiana.

priorities.definition: On matched active contexts, retain visitor-specific interaction weights and calculate Shannon using a prespecified denominator.
priorities.why: The predeclared unconditional Shannon contrast is less negative in synthetic sign-rescue cases, but it partly inherits zero coding from locally inactive contexts and is therefore secondary to ranks 1-2.

priorities.definition: Retain source-native plant functional position and direct reproductive dependency when available, but do not require them to explain network rescue before local support is measured.
priorities.why: Initial trait means are nearly identical between sign rescue and attenuation-only in the frozen discriminator, while dependency differs modestly and is not the branch generator in prior ablations.

system_readiness.current_strength: visitor counts, repeated observation segments and breeding treatments are source-supported
service/assurance and visitor-specific per-visit effectiveness are reported across linked studies
system_readiness.blocking_priority: stable source provenance plus prespecified site-year linkage before formal E_k use

system_readiness.current_strength: repeated visitation/contact/robbing and reproductive performance plus historical trait matching
system_readiness.blocking_priority: same-context controlled dependency and exact row-level repeated-context linkage

system_readiness.current_strength: prospective linked effort, visitor identity, SVD effectiveness and reproductive-treatment protocol is implementation-ready
direct single-visit pollen deposition and dependency at Yongxing plus visitation/outcome contrast across islands
system_readiness.blocking_priority: matched Dong-side effectiveness/dependency and repeated local support

forbidden: change the frozen network-context empirical prediction rule to fit the discriminator
treat repeated active-context fraction as a causal buffer coefficient
use static regional richness as a replacement for repeated local support
infer E_k from visitor identity, body size or abundance
privilege Campanula or any other single focal taxon as the only route
next_gate: Apply these measurement priorities only when a named system exposes new source-native matched data or prospective measurements. Until then, keep network context as a replicated synthetic branch allocator with empirical mechanism admission open but unfilled.
